description: PromptWars: Virtual is a weekly vibe coding challenge , where individual participants build applications using prompts against curated problem statements or use cases. Each submission includes a functional project and an accompanying technical blog detailing the problem, prompt strategy, and solution. The program promotes a shift from code-intensive workflows to prompt-driven, GenAI-powered application development, enabling developers to significantly reduce build times and focus on ideation, innovation, and real-world problem solving. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced builder, this is your playground to solve industry challenges and build the future, one prompt at a time.

problem_sources.text: Build a GenAI-enabled solution that enhances stadium operations and the overall tournament experience for fans, organizers, volunteers, or venue staff. The solution must leverage Generative AI to improve navigation, crowd management, accessibility, transportation, sustainability, multilingual assistance, operational intelligence, or real-time decision support during the FIFA World Cup 2026.
problem_sources.title: [Challenge 4] Smart Stadiums & Tournament Operations
